What changed between two expert systems

Source: R/resy_diff_expert.R
resy_diff_expert.Rd

Compares two expert systems, for example two releases of EUNIS-ESy, and lists every aggregate, species group and type that was added, removed or changed. Systems are compared after parsing, so a .txt and a .json file can be compared with each other and differences in layout or line endings do not count as changes.

Usage

resy_diff_expert(from, to, scheme = "EUNIS")

Arguments

from, to

The two expert systems: a resy_parsed_expert from resy_load_expert(), the path of an expert file, or a version of scheme available to resy_load_expert() (see resy_available_classifications()).

scheme

Scheme of from and to when they are given as versions.

Value

A data frame of class resy_expert_diff, one row per change, with columns

section

"aggregate" (Section 1 aggregation of taxa), "group" (Section 2 species group) or "type" (Section 3 definition).

key

Aggregate name, group name or type code.

change

"added", "removed" or "changed".

what

For a changed aggregate or group, the members that were added (+) and removed (-); for a changed type, which of priority, name and formula changed.

from, to

For a type, the definition (priority, name and formula) in each system; NA where the type is absent. For an aggregate or group, the number of members.

print() shows the number of changes per section; summary() lists the changed keys.

See also

resy_load_expert(), resy_available_classifications()

Examples

# \donttest{
d <- resy_diff_expert("2020-06-08", "2021-06-01")
d
#> Changes from EUNIS 2020-06-08 (expert.txt.xz) to EUNIS 2021-06-01 (expert.txt.xz):
#>    section added removed changed
#>  aggregate   180      18     214
#>      group    34      31      47
#>       type    41      28      15
summary(d)
